entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Shivnarayan S/o Keshra Ram, R/o Hemeran P.S. Napasar  Dist. Bikaner  ----Respondents For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Mohd. Ali Rao.

For Respondent(s) : Mr. Mahipal Bishnoi, P.P.
 Mr. Shree Kant Verma.

HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE KULDEEP MATHUR Order 21/04/2023 This application for bail under Section 439 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the petitioner who has been arrested in connection with F.I.R. No.119/2022, registered at Police Station Napasar, District Bikaner, for offences under Sections 376(2)(n), 376(3), 384, 386, 506, 323 IPC and Sections 3/4, 5L/6 POCSO Act.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that the petitioner, aged about 21 years had a friendly relationship with the prosecutrix, aged about 17 years.

Learned counsel submitted that the F.I.R. in the case has been lodged after a considerable delay of more than one and half years, and therefore,
in order to cover up [2023/RJJD/011284] (2 of 3) [CRLMB-14298/2022] this delay, the allegation of extorting an amount of Rs.7,50,000/- from the prosecutrix by blackmailing her has been levelled Bajrang Jat vs State Of Rajasthan (2023/Rjjd/011284) on 21 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/167838855/
1 against the petitioner.

entities.text: Bajrang Jat vs State Of Rajasthan (2023/Rjjd/011284)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Lastly, it was submitted that though certain photographs have been recovered by the Investigating Agency from the mobile phone of the petitioner but no obscene photographs as alleged in the F.I.R. have been recovered.

Learned counsel further submitted that looking at closeness in the age of the petitioner and the prosecutrix, so also the fact that both were in friendly relationship for more than one and half years, it can be contended that the petitioner has been falsely implicated and is an innocent person.
Challan of the case has already been filed.
The petitioner is in judicial custody and the trial of the case will take sufficiently long time, therefore, the benefit of bail should be granted to the accused-petitioner.
Learned Public Prosecutor and learned counsel for the complainant have opposed the bail application.

Having considered the rival submissions, facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on merits/demerits of the case, this Court is of the opinion that the bail application filed by the petitioner deserves to be accepted.
Consequently, the bail application under Section 439 Cr.P.C. is allowed.

It is ordered that the accused-petitioner Bajrang Jat S/o Shri Gopal Ram arrested in connection with F.I.R. No.119/2022,
registered at Police Station Napasar, District Bikaner, shall be released on bail, if not wanted in any other case, provided he furnishes a personal bond of Rs.50,000/- and two sureties of Rs.25,000/-
each, to the satisfaction of learned trial [2023/RJJD/011284] (3 of 3) [CRLMB-14298/2022] court,
for his appearance before that court on each & every date of hearing and whenever called upon to do so till completion of the trial.
